title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.

title: Talk 1
original: I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.

title: Talk 2
original: Wow, I never imagined Oripathy would have such a trait! This requires immediate testing… Um, Doctor, I'm sorry, but I need to leave now. Hmm, I wonder if there's a suitable subject on base…

title: Talk 3
original: The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the finest Victorian leaves here.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past from before we met. Oh, but I won't give that up so easily, Doctor.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other Infected too...? Relax, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure for Schwarz, which is why I longed to join Rhodes Island since I first heard of it.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Do you know, Doctor, that I despise those who discriminate against Schwarz on account of her infection alone? But here, she is accepted, and I can learn more about medicine. Coming to Rhodes Island was truly the right decision.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: No matter how good a leader is, there's still a chance to be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. Hehe, but still, you don't need to worry that much. As long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.

title: Idle
original: Falling asleep in a sitting position is a nasty habit, Doctor. Let me get you a blanket, at least.

title: Onboard
original: Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of Victoria National University, with a major in Originium research. I start my internship at Rhodes Island today, with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation.

title: Promotion 1
original: So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder.

title: Promotion 2
original: Rhodes Island does boast terrific Originium research. If I keep working here, I'm sure I will cure Schwarz one day. Doctor, please help me on this path.

title: Added to Squad
original: A mission? A perfect opportunity to test my Originium Arts.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Relax, I'm a confident commander.

title: Depart
original: I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?

title: Begin Operation
original: Don't panic, handle it with composure.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Where are the wounded?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Hmm?

title: Deployment 1
original: Leave the support work to me.

title: Deployment 2
original: If you're wounded, don't move.

title: In Battle 1
original: You're all free to focus on the mission.

title: In Battle 2
original: Concentrate on the enemy ahead!

title: In Battle 3
original: This one should be better for the present situation.

title: 4-star Result
original: Phew... I feel like I just wrapped up a difficult experiment. It's tiring, but very fulfilling too.

title: 3-star Result
original: The enemy should be gone now...  Alright then, I'm going to look around the perimeter.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: If I were as good as Schwarz, they wouldn't have gotten away…

title: Operation Failure
original: Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Hm, maybe I could talk to the other doctors on base.

title: Tap
original: Wait, my hair is getting messed up!

title: Trust Tap
original: Did the Doctor fall asleep in that chair again?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. Yes, I'll go and chat with my Medical Department colleagues for a while, and then meet up with Schwarz later on. New Year's could never be more interesting at home than at Rhodes Island, and I've sent my father a card in any case.

title: Greeting
original: How are you, Doctor? Care for some tea with me?

title: Birthday
original: Here's your birthday present, Doctor. I know what it's like. You bury yourself in books or research, and you just can't help forgetting to take breaks. But with a tea set this beautiful by your side, I'm sure you'll be more minded to pause and brew a cup... hm? Oh, don't worry, it wasn't... terribly expensive.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I might have gained new knowledge from my predecessors' writings at university. However, only after sailing such a long course with Rhodes Island, have I truly touched on the breadth of this land, and gained all kinds of experience the books never held. Ah, and on top of that, Schwarz is doing wonderfully here. Thank you all for looking after her.
